readOnly: {{name}} is read-only in odin-db, but the shell runs with your database user's permissions. Use a read-only database user to prevent changes.

missing.title: mongosh not found
missing.body: The shell runs MongoDB's own mongosh. Install it and make sure it is on your PATH, then open the shell again.

disconnected.title: {{name}} is disconnected
disconnected.body: Connect again to start a shell.
